title: Membership State
summary: Keep a set of exactly the values that should count as already seen so future items can answer yes/no membership questions quickly.
recognition_signals: the question asks whether a value has appeared before
deduplication or visited-state checks are required
core_rules: The set must represent exactly the items whose membership should count at the current point in the scan.
Check membership before or after insertion according to whether the current item is allowed to match itself.
structural_steps: for each item, ask whether the relevant value is already present
insert or remove state when the item's membership should start or stop counting

common_confusions.distinction: Use membership state when only yes/no presence matters. Use keyed lookup state when the algorithm needs counts, indexes, or other metadata per key.
